profile.headline: A creative Software Engineer with a background in cyber security and streaming video delivery, focused on creating innovative solutions for customers.
profile.summary:
Software engineer experienced in all phases of software development. Enhanced existing products with innovative new features and designed new applications from conception. Implemented requirements and improved product quality in an Agile environment.


Key Compentencies: Linux • Perl • Python • Java • Agile Development • Cybersecurity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the DevOps team responsible for creating and managing the ViaSat Content Delivery System (VCDS).  VCDS functioned as a CDN for Disney+ and delivered video to inflight airplanes as well as home subscribers. Developed software for many elements of the VCDS system, from the embedded client to AWS cloud components to proxy servers and monitoring systems.

Wrote Python code for AWS lambda functions that processed messages from Kinesis or SQS and then accessed DynamoDB or InfluxDB.

Fixed bugs and implemented new features in Clojure for the VCDS management system.
Maintained the embedded VCDS multicast client, fixing bugs and adding new features in C and also creating unit tests utilizing google’s C++ testing framework.

Created an OpenAPI specification for open caching purge functionality, which was imported into AWS API Gateway. Implemented a python lambda function to process the JSON body of the purge request and post it to an SQS queue.

Developed Ansible playbooks to manage and deploy VCDS components into the AWS cloud, Vmware servers and onto physical hardware.

Composed behavior-based test scenarios and developed Python step functions for system and scale testing to ensure VCDS met its expected SLOs.

Designed and implemented a service plan information web page utilizing jinja templates on the VCDS’s tornado based monitoring web server. 

Worked in a fast-paced agile scrum environment to develop VCDS software elements and support the 24/7 delivery of video to airlines.

Wrote integration tests in Python for the VCDS REST API, embedded client, and system control component.

Developed Grafana dashboards to display embedded client read and write errors based on queries to an InfluxDB database.

Maintained the VCDS CI/CD pipeline by configuring build and deployment Jenkins jobs, which then ran Ansible playbooks.

Worked with NGINX in a variety of functions; as a reverse proxy, an online cache and in the OpenCaching role of request router.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Streaming Media · Grafana · C (Programming Language) · InfluxDB · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Jenkins · Behavior Based Testing · Clojure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sole engineer for the Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) appliance, then transitioned to the vulnerability service project to identify unpatched vulnerabilities (CVE’s) on customer systems.

* Proposed vulnerability service architecture utilizing micro-services connected to a MongoDB server and utilizing a Rest API.

• Developed an agent in Java to retrieve CVE and patch data from WisdomOS and store the transformed results in MongoDB. 

• Extended open source Python project cve-search project to collect vulnerability data from nist.gov and store it in MongoDB.

• Created agents in Python and Java to download CPE data from remote servers and store it in a MongoDB database. 

• Developed curses based Perl application to manage Snort rules, variables and thresholds.
Proposed, designed and implemented a new network-analytics agent in Python for the NIDS to report IP traffic statistics. 

• Refactored Perl agent that processed Snort exceptions and defined new metrics for classifying events.

positions.title: Senior QA Analyst
positions.description: Test planning and validation of Industrial Defender's security management system on Linux, UNIX and Windows platforms in a variety of physical and virtual environments.

positions.title: Senior QA contractor
positions.description: Quality Assurance engineer testing Industrial Defender's risk mitigation technology platform that protects both new and legacy industrial control and SCADA systems

positions.title: Quality Assurance engineer
positions.description:
QA engineer responsible for testing Novell's enterprise Linux desktop operating systems and applications, including software configuration management and groupware clients.

●  Developed the STASIS framework in Perl for running automated test cases, with an XML-RPC interface to Testopia and STAF integration.

●  Led effort that successfully integrated testing of Novell Linux Desktop 9 by QA teams from Ximian, Novell and SuSE.

●  Created test plans for Novell Linux Desktop 9 and SuSE Linux Enterprise Desktop 10 and led weekly meetings to coordinate testing with Novell QA teams located in the United States (Utah and Massachusetts), Europe and India.

●  Shipped Novell Linux Desktop 9 with high quality despite the mid stream incorporation of technology from Novell's acquisition of SuSE Linux AG.
